description: Get the full offensive and defensive type effectiveness breakdown. Provide either a type name (e.g. "fire", "psychic") or a Pokémon identifier (name or PokéAPI Pokémon-record ID). For dual-type Pokémon, the defensive multipliers are correctly composed (e.g. Fire/Flying vs Rock = 4× because both types are weak to Rock). Exactly one of type or pokemon must be provided.

pokemon.description: Pokémon name or PokéAPI Pokémon-record ID. The server resolves the types automatically. Provide this or type, not both.

type.description: Type name in lowercase (e.g. "fire", "water", "psychic"). Provide this or pokemon, not both.

name: pokeapi_get_type_matchups

composedMultipliers.description: Multiplier (0, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4) for every attacking type touched by at least one of the resolved defending type(s), including net-neutral 1× entries where a dual type composes to a cancellation (e.g. Fire/Flying vs Ice: 0.5× then 2× = 1×). A type absent from this map relates to neither defending type and also deals 1× damage.

defensiveMatchups.description: Defensive matchups — composed correctly for dual-type Pokémon.

resists.description: Attacking types that deal 0.5× or less damage (but not immune).

weakTo.description: Attacking types that deal 2× or more damage.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: The type name or Pokémon identifier was not found in PokéAPI. `invalid_input`: Neither type nor pokemon was provided, or both were provided simultaneously. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

noEffectTo.description: Types this type deals 0× damage to (immune).

notVeryEffectiveTo.description: Types this type deals 0.5× damage to.

superEffectiveTo.description: Types this type deals 2× damage to.

offensiveRelations.description: Offensive effectiveness (populated for single-type queries; null for dual-type Pokémon where per-type breakdown does not compose cleanly).

queryType.description: How the query was resolved: "type" for a direct type query, "pokemon" for a Pokémon lookup.

resolvedTypes.description: The type name(s) the query resolved to.

title: Get Type Matchups
